scenario: Blackboard action execution with a centered three-pane editor
source: Interactive Unity Editor Play Mode regression check
criteria: The left Block authoring pane remains visible at the narrow dock width.
The Blackboard graph remains centered between equal-width side panes.
The selected action inspector remains visible on the right.
The Game Started block executes its enabled actions.
The final Debug Log action writes "Wait 5 seconds" to the Console.
Returning to Edit Mode does not report an IMGUI or stale SerializedObject error.
